textblock_204533102__313186556.text:
^ On December 12, 2024, the Port Authority of NY & NJ Board authorized incentivizing proper positioning of E-ZPass Tags by introducing a new Mid-Tier toll rate across all vehicles classes with a NY/NJ E-ZPass account effective, July 6, 2025. This new tier (affecting 9% of transactions) is intended for drivers to take advantage of lower E-ZPass rates by ensuring their Tags are mounted properly on the vehicle windshield for accurate reading by the toll collection system at the time of crossing. 

NY/NJ E-ZPass account customers whose E-ZPass Tags are not properly mounted and not positioned for accurate readings while traveling Port Authority crossings, will be charged a Mid-Tier rate for their tolls. The Mid-Tier rate is higher to cover the incremental cost to process the toll transaction (license plate picture and account verification), however, the Mid-Tier rate is lower than the full toll rate with Tolls by Mail.

For Staten Island Bridges Plan (PASI) customers, the Mid-Tier rate is $9.78 per peak or off-peak trip (plus $17.55 for each additional axle beyond two axles), $19.55 if one or two trips are taken.

† Where the rear most axle of the motorized unit has dual rear wheels or super-single tires.

* Effective July 12, 2026, the Port Authority updated the bus classifications to better align toll rates with vehicle size and operating characteristics. The current Class 8 Bus category was revised to distinguish between two-axle mini buses that are less than 32 feet long and two-axle buses that are 32 feet or longer. Class 9 continues to apply to three-axle buses and mini buses. E-ZPass Tags are required to receive the bus toll rate.

+ Visit our E-ZPass page for plan descriptions, eligibility, and enrollment information.

Please Note: Customer license plate number(s) are required to be correctly registered to an active NY/NJ E-ZPass account in good standing to prevent Tolls by Mail invoices and to ensure either the E-ZPass (Peak/Off-Peak) rate or Mid-Tier rate.

Please Note: All E-ZPass discounts apply only to New York and New Jersey E-ZPass account holders.

If you have unused Port Authority Toll Scrip tickets, click here for refund instructions.

imagewithtext_copy_c_1264490485.title: Toll Bill Customer Service Options
imagewithtext_copy_c_1264490485.text:
To help you resolve your questions in an efficient manner, please review the following to make sure you connect with the appropriate support team:

  • If your current unpaid violations are in collections and your vehicle registration is not suspended, please continue to work with the collection agency directly.
    • Southwest Credit: 1-877-391-0160  or www.swcconsumer.com
    • Alliance One: 1-866-505-2158 or www.allianceoneinc.com 
      • Or affiliate PMT Solutions: www.pmt-solutions.com
    • Transworld Systems Inc.: 1-866-246-0157 or https://tsico.com
  • If you have E-ZPass account maintenance issues, please contact the E-ZPass Customer Service Center (CSC).
    • NY E-ZPass customers contact NY E-ZPass CSC directly:
      1 800 333 - TOLL (8655) or www.e-zpassny.com
    • NJ E-ZPass customers contact NJ E-ZPass CSC directly:
      1 888 AUTO - TOLL (288-6865) or www.ezpassnj.com

textblock_1960420353.title: Don't Ignore Your Toll Problems. Solve Them.
textblock_1960420353.text: The Port Authority of NY & NJ Toll Payer Advocate (TPA) is a free service providing an objective investigation into toll issues that the E-ZPass or Tolls by Mail customer service centers are unable to resolve. We can find and implement solutions with the registered owner of the vehicle.

textblock.title: How We Can Help
textblock.text:
While there is no automatic fee dismissal program offered for Port Authority crossings, the TPA is a resource for customers to explain and address unresolved tolling issues, including:

  • Understanding your tolls and fees at Port Authority crossings
  • Researching overcharged tolls
  • Investigating when vehicles do not belong to the violator
  • Addressing vehicle registration suspensions

textblock_1428492305.title: Before Requesting Our Help
textblock_1428492305.text:
Before contacting the TPA, please make sure the vehicle owner has already contacted the E-ZPass New York Service Center (800-333-8655) to resolve the issue. If the vehicle has a Port Authority registration suspension, please contact the DMV suspension line (718-313-9425).

We cannot assist you until you have first contacted at least one of the three services listed above.

Also, please confirm that your issue specifically relates to a Port Authority bridge or tunnel:

  • George Washington Bridge (GWB)
  • Lincoln Tunnel (LT) 
  • Holland Tunnel (HT)
  • Bayonne Bridge (BB)
  • Goethals Bridge (GB)
  • Outerbridge Crossing (OBX)

If your issue is not related to one of these crossings, you may wish to contact MTA Bridges and Tunnels Office of the Toll Payer Advocate, New York State Thruway Authority Office of the Toll Payer Advocate, or New Jersey Turnpike Authority.

textblock_1428492305_1110763803.title: Request Our Help
textblock_1428492305_1110763803.text:
If you have been unsuccessful in resolving your issue through the resources listed above, we may be able to assist you. Click the link below to request assistance:

Request assistance

Within 10 days, the registered owner of the vehicle will receive an email acknowledgement from the TPA. The TPA must correspond directly with the registered owner. Please do not use email related to relatives or friends. Following acknowledgement of the case, please allow at least four weeks for a response. Please periodically check your inbox and spam folders for messages from “Toll Payer Advocate.”

textblock_945924832.title: Keep your account up to date
textblock_945924832.text:
It's essential to keep your contact information up to date to stay informed about your toll activity. Here's how to do that:

  • For E-ZPass customers: To update your details, go to "My Account" on the E-ZPass website. You can update your contact information under the "Account Settings" tab.
  • For Tolls by Mail customers: Use the toll bill number from a recent bill to access your account on the Tolls by Mail website. Once logged in, navigate to “My Account” and select “Communication Preferences.” You can then update or add your email address. This applies even if you have an E-ZPass account.

textblock_945924832__685784729.title: Related Information
textblock_945924832__685784729.text:
• Unpaid violations may also be collected by one of these collections agencies: Southwest Credit, AllianceOne (or affiliate PMT Solutions), and Transworld Systems Inc. If a collection call seems suspicious, you can verify by contacting the agency directly using the number on their respective official website, linked above or the ones below:
    • Southwest Credit: 1-877-391-0160
    • AllianceOne: 1-866-505-2158
    • Transworld Systems Inc.: 1-866-246-0157
  • Significant unpaid violations may be pursued through civil action by the Merani Law Firm. If a call seems suspicious, you can verify by contacting the Merani Law Firm directly using the number on their official website, linked above or at 1-929-458-6275.

imagewithtext_copy_c_871261766.text:
Cashless tolling is a streamlined way for you to travel by allowing you to pay for your tolls on New York bridges, tunnels, and highways without stopping.

  • What are the benefits of Cashless Tolling?

  • Why is it important to update my license and vehicle registration information with the DMV?
  • What happens if I don’t pay tolls or respond to toll bills in a timely manner?
  • Learn more about Cashless Tolling.

imagewithtext_copy.title: E-ZPass
imagewithtext_copy.text:
E-ZPass is the easiest way to save on all your bridge, tunnel, and highway tolls in New York. With E-ZPass, you can save over 36% on your toll bill. To learn more about E-ZPass, please see the links below.

  • What are the benefits of E-ZPass?
  • How can I get E-ZPass if I don’t have a credit card?
  • How do I avoid common E-ZPass issues?
  • To learn even more about E-ZPass, visit E-ZPass New York or E-ZPass New Jersey.

imagewithtext_copy_c.title: Tolls by Mail
imagewithtext_copy_c.text:
All vehicles traveling through a cashless tolling facility without an E-ZPass Tag will receive a Toll Bill mailed to the registered owner of the vehicle. Tolls by Mail customers pay the full toll and do not receive any E-ZPass discounts.

  • How can I see my Tolls by Mail balance?
  • How can I pay if I don’t have a credit card or bank account?
  • For other Tolls by Mail frequently asked questions, visit the Tolls by Mail website.

imagewithtext_copy_c_109575955.title: Toll Payer Advocates
imagewithtext_copy_c_109575955.text:
Toll Payer Advocates (TPAs) investigate E-ZPass and Tolls by Mail toll issues that the New York Customer Service Center is unable to resolve. Each cashless tolling agency (MTA Bridges & Tunnels, the New York State Thruway Authority, and the Port Authority of NY & NJ) have Toll Payer Advocates who can address issues at their various bridges, tunnels, and highways.

  • How can a TPA help resolve my toll issue?
  • When can I reach out to a TPA?
  • How do I know which TPA to contact?

textblock_204533102_.text:
^ On December 12, 2024, the Port Authority of NY & NJ Board authorized incentivizing proper positioning of E-ZPass Tags by introducing a new Mid-Tier toll rate across all vehicles classes with a NY/NJ E-ZPass account effective, July 6, 2025. This new tier (affecting 9% of transactions) is intended for drivers to take advantage of lower E-ZPass rates by ensuring their Tags are mounted properly on the vehicle windshield for accurate reading by the toll collection system at the time of crossing. 

NY/NJ E-ZPass account customers whose E-ZPass Tags are not properly mounted and not positioned for accurate readings while traveling Port Authority crossings, will be charged a Mid-Tier rate for their tolls. The Mid-Tier rate is higher to cover the incremental cost to process the toll transaction (license plate picture and account verification), however, the Mid-Tier rate is lower than the full toll rate with Tolls by Mail.

For Staten Island Bridges Plan (PASI) customers, the Mid-Tier rate is $9.78 per peak or off-peak trip (plus $17.55 for each additional axle beyond two axles), $19.55 if one or two trips are taken.

† Where the rear most axle of the motorized unit has dual rear wheels or super-single tires.

* Effective July 12, 2026, the Port Authority updated the bus classifications to better align toll rates with vehicle size and operating characteristics. The current Class 8 Bus category was revised to distinguish between two-axle mini buses that are less than 32 feet long and two-axle buses that are 32 feet or longer. Class 9 continues to apply to three-axle buses and mini buses.

+ Visit our E-ZPass page for plan descriptions, eligibility, and enrollment information.

Please Note: Customer license plate number(s) are required to be correctly registered to an active NY/NJ E-ZPass account in good standing to prevent Tolls by Mail invoices and to ensure either the E-ZPass (Peak/Off-Peak) rate or Mid-Tier rate.

Please Note: All E-ZPass discounts apply only to New York and New Jersey E-ZPass account holders.
